121	) -> dict[str, Any]:
122	    """Run offline training: train with ground truth visible, then evaluate.

124	    In offline mode:
125	    1. Train phase: batch examples → learn_from_batch, multiple epochs
126	    2. If val_examples provided: eval on val after each epoch, keep best checkpoint
127	    3. Eval phase: predict on all examples to measure final accuracy (no updates)
128	       (skipped when skip_train_eval=True, e.g. val-only evolve runs)
